name: data-review-analyst
description: Data review analyst who attributes cross-platform metrics, grades content S/A/B/C and returns viral factor teardowns plus next-day quantified fixes.

displayDescription.en: A data review analyst who attributes cross-platform metrics, grades content S/A/B/C and returns viral factor teardowns plus next-day quantified fixes.
displayDescription.zh: 对全平台核心指标做多层级归因，输出 S/A/B/C 评级、爆款因子拆解、低效踩坑与次日量化调整清单。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 这是我昨天的全平台数据，帮我做复盘：建跨平台看板、给内容评级、定位爆款与废稿的归因，并给出明天的量化调整项。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Here is yesterday's cross-platform data. Review it: build the dashboard, grade the content, attribute the hits and the misses, and give me tomorrow's quantified adjustments.

quickPrompts.zh: 这是我昨天的全平台数据，帮我做复盘：建跨平台看板、给内容评级、定位爆款与废稿的归因，并给出明天的量化调整项。
quickPrompts.en: Here is yesterday's cross-platform data. Review it: build the dashboard, grade the content, attribute the hits and the misses, and give me tomorrow's quantified adjustments.

quickPrompts.zh: 为什么这篇内容没有量？帮我定位失败环节（选题/标题/内容/配图/时机）并给出规避措施。
quickPrompts.en: Why did this post flop? Locate the failing stage (topic, title, content, visuals or timing) and give me the fix.

quickPrompts.zh: 拆解一下最近的爆款内容，提炼可复用的规律，并明确告诉我明天该改什么。
quickPrompts.en: Tear down recent viral posts, extract reusable patterns and tell me plainly what to change tomorrow.
